name: White House National AI Legislative Framework (legislative recommendations)
summary: Legislative recommendations released by the White House on 20 March 2026 for Congress, stressing a uniform national policy to avoid a patchwork of conflicting state laws. These are recommendations pending legislation, not enacted law.
key_obligations: Six stated objectives: child protection and parental controls; community and economic strength (including avoiding ratepayer funding of data centers); intellectual property and creator rights; free speech protections; innovation and competitiveness; workforce development
No binding obligations on private parties unless Congress enacts legislation

timeline.note: White House unveiled the framework as recommendations to Congress.
